title: CNMD - DockingStation schema
description: Schema for a soft-mobility vehicle docking station.

addressLocality.description: The locality, which must correspond to the municipality

addressRegion.description: The NUTS 2 region in which the locality is located

district.description: The administrative district in which the locality is located

type.description: Property. NGSI entity type. It must be DockingStation.

agency_fare_url.description: Property. URL of a web page containing fare details.

agency_name.description: Property. Full name of the transport agency.

agency_url.description: Property. URL of the transport agency.

availableVehicleNumber.description: Property. Number of soft-mobility vehicles available at the station.

freeSlotNumber.description: Property. Number of available docks for returning and parking bicycles or scooters. It must be less than or equal to totalSlotNumber minus outOfServiceSlotNumber.

mediaURL.description: Property. URL providing additional information, images, or other media related to the station.

observationDate.description: Property. Date and time of the latest observation, in ISO 8601 format.

openingHours.description: Property. Opening hours of the docking station.

outOfServiceSlotNumber.description: Property. Number of unavailable docks. It must be less than or equal to totalSlotNumber.

provider.description: Property. Provider of the docking service.

stationCode.description: Property. Number or code of the docking station.

stationName.description: Property. Name of the docking station.

status.description: Property. Current status of the docking station.

totalSlotNumber.description: Property. Total number of docks offered by the station.
